topic.label: Derivatives and Options
topic.desc: Contracts whose value derives from something else: options, futures and forwards, swaps, pricing and Greeks, and hedging strategies.

concepts: Calls and puts, strikes and expiries, intrinsic and time value, and options chains.
Futures and forward contracts, margin, contango and backwardation, and roll.
Interest rate swaps, credit default swaps, currency swaps and total return swaps.
Black-Scholes and binomial pricing, implied volatility and the Greeks.
Using derivatives to hedge: protective puts, collars, futures hedges and delta hedging.
skills: Builds the payoff and break-even for an option or multi-leg options strategy.
Reads an options chain and explains open interest, implied volatility and skew.
Explains futures roll, contango and backwardation and their cost.
Explains how a swap's legs are valued and what moves its value.
Prices a call or put option and computes its Greeks with Black-Scholes and states the assumptions.
Designs a hedge for an exposure and compares cost and residual risk.
